workspaceLayouts.chooser: After each login, every authenticated staff member chooses Dapur, Garson, or Manajemen. Refresh retains the active session choice; the switch icon beside logout resets it. A null role exposes no operational data or actions. Three ruled columns become one column at 767px.
workspaceLayouts.kitchen: Full-width production KDS, dark station header, horizontal queue/availability tabs, Manrope headings and 1920px canvas. Queue beside a 290px sticky demand panel (top 20px, gap 25px); 240px panel at 768–1100px. At 767px replace the panel with a collapsible summary above the one-column queue.
workspaceLayouts.waiter: Paper service header, horizontal customer/delivery/availability workflow, active-transaction, ready-unit and running-order counters, and 1300px canvas. One Buat order action opens a searchable active-transaction combobox; only unmatched names can create a new transaction. Tabs scroll and counters retain three columns on mobile.
workspaceLayouts.manager: Fixed report sidebar with summary, read-only transaction history (Arsip transaksi), catalogue and settings. Sidebar widths 240px, 210px at 1200px, 190px at 1000px; 250px off-canvas drawer at 767px.
workspaceLayouts.responsive: At 1000px chooser horizontal padding is 30px; kitchen/waiter padding is 25px. At 767px chooser choices stack, kitchen/waiter padding is 18px, compact account metadata truncates, and station/service annotations hide.

transactionWorkflow.terminology: Transaksi is the customer grouping previously called Tab; Pesanan is one timestamped submission. Orders belong directly to transactions without order sessions or time-gap grouping. Login/workspace sessions remain separate.
transactionWorkflow.detail: Wide ivory dialog with total outstanding balance followed by timestamped orders, each with total, paid and remaining amounts and unit rows. An active Garson transaction has a 44px rename icon beside its customer title. Management detail is read-only.
transactionWorkflow.closure: A transaction closes only when financial and operational obligations are complete.
transactionWorkflow.kitchenDemand: Group waiting, accepted and cooking units by menu; Belum mulai sums waiting plus accepted, Dimasak shows cooking. Exclude ready, delivered and cancelled units. Sticky desktop/tablet panel; native collapsible Perlu dimasak summary on phones.
transactionWorkflow.managementMetrics: Transaksi belum selesai includes paid but operationally unfinished transactions. Pilihan pelanggan counts ordered portions minus cancellations regardless of payment state. Active balances/unfinished counts show current state; order values and payments follow event periods.
transactionWorkflow.menuImport: Download Excel template, select .xlsx up to 500 KB and 1,000 menu rows, preview create/update/error counts and row details, then commit the validated file atomically. Show validation/commit errors. Same names update, new names create; historic order prices remain unchanged. Photo import is excluded; upload remains deferred pending Supabase Storage.

narrative.overview:
The restaurant's menu book supplies the material language: ivory paper, charcoal ink, fine warm rules, expressive serif headings, and restrained brick red. Three distinct staff workspaces apply that language to their tasks: a full-width kitchen production board, a horizontal waiter service workflow, and a management report sidebar. A shared role chooser introduces these spaces after login. The customer portal opens it into a photographic menu with more generous editorial headings.

This is a source-first record of the implemented Operate-mode app, extracted from `PRODUCT.md`, `src/styles.css`, `src/StaffWorkspaces.jsx`, `src/main.jsx`, `src/TransactionPanels.jsx`, `src/ManagementOverview.jsx`, `src/CreateOrder.jsx`, and `src/MenuImport.jsx`. The transaction, kitchen-demand, reporting, and Excel-import extension continues this incumbent world. The PRD's menu-book direction informs the world; no approved image composition is claimed. The frontmatter records the default implementation tokens. Restaurant settings can override primary and secondary CSS variables at runtime, so those two values are defaults rather than immutable restaurant identity colors.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory surfaces and thin warm dividers.
Newsreader editorial headings paired with Manrope controls, supporting copy, and kitchen production headings.
Restrained brick-red actions and explicit service status labels.
Compact staff workflows and a photographic customer menu.
donts: **Don't** turn every ledger row into a floating card or spread the mobile cart shadow to ordinary panels.
**Don't** use accent color as a replacement for readable labels or status text.
**Don't** present sample photography as confirmed restaurant catalogue assets.
**Don't** erase wrapping, horizontal tab scrolling, or mobile cart access when extending the layout.
dos: **Do** keep ivory paper, charcoal ink, and warm rules as the main reading structure.
**Do** preserve the Newsreader and Manrope role split.
**Do** pair service colors with explicit Indonesian labels.
**Do** preserve the implemented 44px action targets and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** keep example catalogue photography clearly disclosed and provide the existing text fallback.
**Do** preserve the three distinct workspace compositions and keep session workspace selection separate from staff identity.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the primary accent for action, focus, and selection; retain paper and ink for the main reading surface.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep editorial headings and emphasized totals in Newsreader; use Manrope for controls, status, operational detail, and kitchen production headings.
